paragraphs: By day, I'm a senior engineer buried in corporate code at a large tech firm. By night, I'm a solo freelancer and store-builder who actually enjoys helping real entrepreneurs win.

Let me be upfront—I am a one-man army. There is no massive agency, no offshore team, and no call center. Just me, my keyboard, and a burning obsession to build high-converting dropshipping stores from scratch. Vanta Forge is not an enterprise, nor is it part of any existing enterprise. It's just me—a solo freelancer operating under this name, building trust one store at a time.
If you're here, you're either just starting out or stuck in the messy middle. I've been there. I've built stores for fun, and now I want to build them for you.
Here is my offer to you: I am offering my full-stack dropshipping assistance to the first 10 people completely free of charge.
What I expect in return: Instead of paying me, you give me two honest video reviews—one at the handover of your completed store, and one a few months later once you start seeing actual results.
These reviews are my golden ticket. They let me skip years of corporate bureaucracy and prove my skills directly to people who matter—founders like you.

Why am I doing this for free? Two reasons: First, I need to build undeniable, real-world trust. I plan to turn Vanta Forge into a full-fledged paid service in the near future. But before I charge a single dollar, I need a solid reputation backed by genuine faces and real success stories. Second, this journey is my R&D. By helping you, I am refining my own playbook so that, eventually, I can scale and launch my own branded dropshipping stores. Your success literally teaches me how to build my own empire later.

Crucial Rule – Payment Gateways (Please read carefully): For your safety and my legal accountability, I will never touch your payment gateways, store credentials, or banking details. I don't want the liability, and you absolutely should not hand that power to a stranger on the internet.

Instead, I will build your entire store front-end, configure your products, and optimize your theme. When it comes to connecting Stripe, PayPal, or any other payment processor, we will guide you in a live call so that you can effortlessly do the payment gateways. You stay in 100% control of your money, at all times. No exceptions.

About Trust, Transparency & Your Reviews: This site is hosted on GitHub Pages—a platform that actively bans scam sites. The backend runs on Cloudflare Workers (all free tiers—I invest nothing until I earn nothing). I do not store any of your store data, customer data, or personal payment info. Your business stays yours.

Now, let's talk about your review videos: Your submitted reviews will live on our public Community Hub—a dedicated space where future clients can see authentic, unedited feedback from real people like you. I, Vanta Forge, give you my word that I will never upload your video or image to any other platform, social media, or external site. Period. They stay strictly within our community hub.
As this startup grows, I may migrate to better, premium hosting in the future. If that happens, your reviews will migrate with the site, as they are part of this project's legacy and journey.

Important Disclaimer: While I fully guarantee my own integrity, I cannot take responsibility for external actors—scrapers, bots, or third parties who might access the public hub. The internet is a public space, and I want to be brutally honest about that. I will never share your media myself, but I cannot control what others do, and I will not take liability for their actions. I just want you to know the truth upfront.

My Commitment to You: I won't disappear after handing over the keys. I stay with you until your store is live, your gateways are connected (by you, with my guidance during the live call), and you feel confident to launch. Why? Because your success story is my future portfolio.
